meta.name: tutor
meta.description: Interactive quiz tutor for Obsidian StudyVault learning. Use when the user wants to: (1) Take a diagnostic assessment of their knowledge, (2) Study or review specific sections/topics, (3) Drill weak areas identified in previous sessions, (4) Check their learning progress or dashboard, or says things like "quiz me", "test me", "let's study", "/tutor", "학습", "퀴즈", "평가".

copy.tagline: 通过交互式测验巩固学习内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用Obsidian做学习笔记并想通过测验检验掌握程度
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian for study notes and want to test your knowledge with quizzes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成一个交互式测验导师。它会先检测你的语言，然后读取 Obsidian 笔记库中的 StudyVault 文件夹，根据你的学习进度生成 4 道选择题，并记录每个概念的掌握情况。
howto.when: 当你在 Obsidian 中说出“考考我”、“测试我”、“学习”等关键词，或要求诊断、复习特定章节、强化薄弱环节时触发。

say.text: 考考我关于 Python 基础的知识。
帮我诊断一下我薄弱的知识点。
say.note: Claude 会检查仪表盘，针对未测量或弱项区域出题。

say.text: 我想复习历史章节的第三部分。
say.note: Claude 会针对指定章节生成测验。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an interactive quiz tutor. It detects your language, reads the StudyVault folder in your Obsidian vault, generates 4 multiple-choice questions based on your progress, and tracks concept-level mastery.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like "quiz me", "test me", "let's study", or ask for a diagnostic, review specific sections, or drill weak areas.

say_en.note: Claude reads Python notes in StudyVault and generates questions.
Claude checks the dashboard and targets unmeasured or weak areas.
Claude creates a quiz for that specific section.
